note: Eswatini, from the Ministry of Home Affairs' Permits page as Common Crawl captured it in August 2026 (the live site didn't answer on 2026-11-03): a foreign employee needs the temporary residence permit's Part I, applied for with the employer's covering letter, proof the post was advertised, police clearance, qualifications and a medical certificate; the application fee has been E300 since 1 March 2021 (the Ministry's notice of revised fees). Nothing is said of performers as such, nor of days of work without the permit; the Special Pass (Form 10), whose use the page doesn't state, isn't modelled.
